title: Elephant Random Walk on the Triangular Lattice
summary: In this report, we introduce the elephant random walk on the triangular lattice over $R^2$ incorporating directions by extending the model developed in \cite{baur2016elephant}. We study the behavior of the walk by finding the appropriate scaling limits. This model was studied as a part of my Master of Statistics, 2018 final year dissertation at Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata.
